MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

3. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 36
   D. 37

4. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 16
   C. 5
   D. 12

5. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

6. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 22
   C. 44
   D. 15

8. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

10. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

12. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27

13. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 11
   C. 29
   D. 28

14. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

15. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 48

16. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 14
   D. 12

17. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

18. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 24

19. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

20. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 64
   C. 8
   D. 9

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 38
   C. 19
   D. 30

22. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

23. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 65
   C. 0
   D. 64

24. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
